page_title: MON 0-1 ACM | Monza v AC Milan 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Mattia Valoti (Monza) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+4' Armando Izzo (Monza) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul.
90+3' Daniel Maldini (Monza) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
90+2' The ratio of the ball possession is 42:58.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christian Pulisic leaves the pitch and Yunus Musah (AC Milan) comes on.
89' Here is a change. Filippo Terracciano is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Davide Calabria (AC Milan).
87' Here comes a substitution. Mattia Valoti (Monza) is brought on as a substitute for Warren Bondo.

85' Nice individual effort by Rafael Leao (AC Milan). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
85' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
84' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
83' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Warren Bondo (Monza), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
82' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:5.
81' It will be a substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is ready to enter the pitch as Samuel Chukwueze walks off.
80' Samuele Vignato (Monza) unleashes a powerful first-time volley towards goal, but the ball goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
78' Alessandro Nesta has decided to make a change. Gianluca Caprari (Monza) replaces Andrea Carboni.
78' Milan Djuric comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mirko Maric (Monza).
75' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
75' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

74' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
72' Warren Bondo (Monza) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
70' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

70' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out for a corner. AC Milan can continue in their attacking effort.
68' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

67' The opposition back off Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the left side of the goal corner, but Stefano Turati denies him with the save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AC Milan.
65' Good clearance! Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
65' Dany Mota will be replaced by Samuele Vignato (Monza).
65' Alessandro Nesta decides to make a substitution. Pedro Pereira will be replaced by Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza).

64' Ambitious effort from Rafael Leao (AC Milan). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
63' Here's the change. Noah Okafor leaves the pitch and Rafael Leao (AC Milan) comes on as a substitute.
61' This shall not pass! Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
60' The resulting set piece from AC Milan is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
59' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan). It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.
58' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
55' Ermano Feliciani couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pablo Mari (Monza) and blew his whistle.
55' Dany Mota (Monza) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
54' Daniel Maldini (Monza) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' The foul by Milan Djuric (Monza) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ermano Feliciani.
51' A long ball forward to Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is intercepted. The linesman signals a throw-in for Monza.
49' Daniel Maldini (Monza) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot! The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.

48' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ermano Feliciani no option but to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Monza, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
47' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
46' Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) makes a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' 0 - 1 Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the left post, and thus alter the score to 0:1.
40' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.

37' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
37' Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Stefano Turati comes off the line to clear the ball away.
34' Dany Mota (Monza) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
34' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:4.
32' Warren Bondo (Monza) makes a strong challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul.
30' Milan Djuric (Monza) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
28' A decent save by Mike Maignan. Pedro Pereira (Monza) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
26' Daniel Maldini (Monza) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

25' Daniel Maldini (Monza) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Mike Maignan sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. Monza force their opponents to concede a corner.
22' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' Wow, what an escape. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
20' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle and it's Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
19' Dany Mota (Monza) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

16' Daniel Maldini (Monza) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
13' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
10' Neat passing move from AC Milan in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Ermano Feliciani due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Dany Mota (Monza) and his team.
4' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
1' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
AC Milan will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ermano Feliciani.
